headlines.title: Mesh Signs Visa Deal to Turn Wallet Crypto and Stablecoin Balances Into Card-Free Payments
headlines.summary: Mesh would act as program manager for participating wallets, with a Visa credential set up in the background so users can pay from crypto and stablecoin balances, and neither company has said when it starts.

headlines.title: Visa and Mesh Partner to Make Crypto and Stablecoin Balances Spendable at 175M+ Visa Merchant Locations
headlines.summary: The stablecoin payments buildout has spent the year assembling rails: Visa Direct moving USDC prefunding into commercial production, Mastercard wiring BVNK stablecoin settlement into 130 countries, and Marqeta and Coinbase building processor-layer settlement on Base. Each solved a different leg: cross-border prefunding, card issuing, and processor integration.

headlines.title: Newline™ by Fifth Third Collaborated with Visa to Enable Fintechs to Offer Visa® Corporate Cards in Over 40 Countries
headlines.summary: LAS VEGAS, October 19, 2026--Newline™ by Fifth Third today announced that eligible U.S.-based fintechs can offer Visa corporate cards for approved business use cases in over 40 countries through Visa's Multinational Program (MNP). Availability is subject to applicable client, program, country, regulatory, financial crimes and sanctions requirements.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
